Why it exists

Move between AI tools without losing your train of thought.

Copying a question into another window loses the path that led to it. AI Assemble keeps your questions, quotes, and each AI's response together, so you can decide where to dig deeper.

01 / CHOOSE

Choose who answers

Select the connected provider and model for a question. Change it as the conversation develops.

02 / QUOTE

Follow up on a specific point

Quote an answer or selected passage and ask the same or another AI about it.

03 / REVISIT

Find the path you took

Reopen locally stored conversations to see the questions and responses behind a conclusion.

User guide

From first question to a useful follow-up.

You control which AI receives each question and what context to share.

STEP 01Connect an AI

Install and sign in to the CLI for the AI you want to use. Check its status and model in Provider settings; compatible API endpoints can be added separately.

STEP 02Choose a workspace

Select the folder the AI may use for context. The app remembers the folder for each conversation.

STEP 03Ask and quote

Choose a data classification and an AI, ask a question, then quote an answer or passage for a follow-up. You can select several AIs for separate responses.

STEP 04Review the record

Find questions, answers, quotes, and follow-ups in the conversation list or search. Hidden state from one AI is not automatically shared with another.

A three-question exampleAsk ChatGPT for a design's strengths and limits → quote one claim and ask Claude what it overlooks → ask Gemini which claims need verification. Each response is an AI perspective, not a fact-check guarantee.
Safety & security

Know where your data stays and where it goes.

AI Assemble uses local records and explicit provider selection. An AI can still make mistakes or act on files it can access.

  • Records on your deviceConversations are stored in a SQLite file in the app data directory. The app does not claim to encrypt this file; protect your device and backups.
  • Context sent to the selected AIQuestions, quotes, needed earlier context, and referenced file contents may be sent to the selected AI or configured API endpoint. Check sensitive material before sending.
  • Confidential classification blocks external AIThe policy check rejects external AI calls for confidential conversations. The public build has no permitted internal-only AI. Internal and normal classifications allow external AI.
  • Your CLI account and workspaceEach supported CLI manages its own sign-in. The app runs it in your chosen workspace, where the AI tool may read or change files. Choose that folder carefully.
  • You verify the resultA second AI is another opinion, not automatic fact-checking. Verify important claims, sources, and file changes yourself.
